tool_suggestions.title: Risk Assessment Review Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard to review and analyze risk assessments for each company, focusing on overall, cyber, and liability risk scores.
features: Visualize overall, cyber, and liability risk scores
Filter and sort assessments by date or company
View AI confidence levels and risk factors

tool_suggestions.title: Claims Management and Resolution Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design an interface to manage, track, and resolve insurance claims efficiently, with options to update status and add adjuster notes.
features: View and filter claims by status (submitted, in progress, resolved)
Update claim status and add or edit adjuster notes
Link related claims and policies for comprehensive view
Analyze AI risk assessment and adjust payments

tool_suggestions.title: Policy Renewal Monitoring Tool
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool to track upcoming policy renewals and manage auto-renew settings for each policy.
features: List policies with upcoming renewal dates and status
Toggle and update auto-renew settings quickly
Send reminders or notifications for manual renewals
Adjust and view premium amounts for renewed policies
